stage: Full chronological 3-fold development evaluation of statistical, state-space, volatility, and tabular quantile baselines

timing_and_purge_rules.train_origin_rule: train_start <= origin_bucket_ts < validation_start and usable[origin] and final_target_available_at < validation_start + 3600 + availability_delay_seconds
timing_and_purge_rules.parameter_fit_cutoff: All per-fold model parameters, scalers, quantiles, innovation pools, and residual copulas use observations strictly with bucket_ts < validation_start (available at <= validation_start + 300, strictly before first validation decision at validation_start + 3900).
timing_and_purge_rules.validation_origin_rule: validation_start <= origin_bucket_ts < validation_end_exclusive and usable[origin] and final_target_available_at < min(validation_end_exclusive + 3600 + availability_delay_seconds, protected_holdout_start)
timing_and_purge_rules.causal_online_filtering: During validation, parametric state-space, EWMA, and GARCH filters update state using only causal observations up to and including origin_bucket_ts with frozen training parameters; no refitting or backward smoothing is permitted.

primary_joint_and_marginal_cohort.name: complete_24h
primary_joint_and_marginal_cohort.definition: Origin hour t is usable and all 24 future hourly buckets t+1..t+24 are usable (25 consecutive usable mid-price observations).
primary_joint_and_marginal_cohort.purpose: Required for joint trajectory metrics (Energy Score, Variogram Score, pathwise max-excursion tail Brier) and exact parity with joint trajectory neural models.

sensitivity_marginal_cohort.name: endpoint_marginal
sensitivity_marginal_cohort.definition: Origin hour t is usable and endpoint hour t+h is usable for h in {1, 4, 24}, regardless of whether intermediate hours between t and t+h had missing/inverted sides.
sensitivity_marginal_cohort.purpose: Quantifies target-completeness / liquidity censoring bias introduced by requiring 24 consecutive usable future hours.

non_overlapping_sensitivity.name: stride_24h
non_overlapping_sensitivity.definition: Subsample complete_24h validation origins with origin_bucket_ts % 86400 == 0 (one non-overlapping 24h trajectory window per day).
non_overlapping_sensitivity.purpose: Verifies rankings are not distorted by 23/24-hour overlapping forecast-error autocorrelation.

liquidity_stratification.manifest_unit_volume_strata: Preserved as recorded in data_manifest.json (ranked by initial-year raw unit volume; known to rank cheap runes/feathers high and high-GP equipment low).
liquidity_stratification.gp_notional_turnover_strata: Computed strictly on initial selection year [1730160000, 1761696000) usable hours via sum(mid_price * (high_price_volume + low_price_volume)), split 25 high / 25 medium / 24 low.
liquidity_stratification.representative_12_item_rule: 4 evenly quantile-spaced items (`np.linspace(0, len(stratum)-1, 4, dtype=int)`) from each initial-year GP-notional tercile (high, medium, low).

scoring_and_selection_rules.fold_item_scale: Per-fold, per-item 1-hour training return scale `scale_{i,f} = max(1.4826 * MAD(r_{train}), 1e-4)` computed strictly on fold f training window.
scoring_and_selection_rules.primary_metric: primary_macro_scaled_crps_1_4_24: for each fold f and item i, average fair sample CRPS(R_hat_{t,h} / scale_{i,f}, R_{t,h} / scale_{i,f}) over item i's eligible validation origins, equal-macro-average across all 74 items, equal-average over h in {1, 4, 24}, then average equally across the 3 chronological folds.

bootstrap_inference.primary_scheme: paired_panel_block_bootstrap moving-block on intact contiguous hourly fold calendar grid [T_f, 74], macro-averaging available items per resampled block
bootstrap_inference.multiplicity_correction: Holm-Bonferroni across candidate baselines tested against gaussian_rw_std and strongest baseline

scoring_and_selection_rules.strongest_calibrated_baseline_selection_: Among full-universe (74-item) E1 baselines whose 3-fold mean nominal 90% prediction interval coverage lies within [0.87, 0.93] at all three registered horizons h in {1, 4, 24}, select the baseline with lowest 3-fold mean primary_macro_scaled_crps_1_4_24. Fallback if empty: select minimum max_{h in {1,4,24}} |cov90_h - 0.90| within 1% of best CRPS and flag calibration miss explicitly.
scoring_and_selection_rules.neural_promotion_gate_for_e2_e4: A neural model family justifies promotion only if it improves 3-fold mean primary_macro_scaled_crps_1_4_24 by >= 2.0% relative over the strongest calibrated E1 baseline while maintaining 90% coverage in [0.87, 0.93]; joint-dependence claims additionally require >= 5.0% relative improvement in macro_scaled_variogram_p05_unbiased over both the strongest marginal/independent baseline and its own horizon-shuffled control.
